# Mixpanel

Mixpanel is a product analytics platform tracking user interactions and engagement, providing cohort analysis, funnels, and A/B testing to improve user experiences

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mixpanel/.

## Actions

- **Execute JQL Query** (read-only): Execute a custom jql (javascript query language) query against mixpanel's query api.
- **Get Aggregate Event Counts** (read-only): Get aggregate event counts over time.
- **Get All Projects** (read-only): Get all projects associated with the authenticated mixpanel account.
- **Get Profile Event Activity** (read-only): Get event activity feed for specified users from mixpanel query api.
- **List Saved Cohorts** (read-only): Get list of all cohorts in a mixpanel project.
- **List Saved Funnels** (read-only): Get the names and funnel ids of your funnels.
- **Query Profiles** (read-only): Query user or group profile data from mixpanel.
- **Query Retention Report** (read-only): Get cohort analysis data.
- **Query Saved Funnel** (read-only): Get data for a funnel.
- **Query Saved Insight** (read-only): Get data from your insights reports.
- **Query Segmentation Report** (read-only): Get data for an event, segmented and filtered by properties.
- **Get Aggregate Events** (read-only): Get aggregate event counts over time.
- **Get Aggregated Event Property Values** (read-only): Get unique, total, or average data for a single event and property over days, weeks, or months.
- **Get Today's Top Events** (read-only): Get the top events for today, with their counts and the normalized percent change from yesterday.
- **Get Top Event Properties** (read-only): Get the top property names for an event.
- **Get Top Event Property Values** (read-only): Get the top values for a property.
- **Get Top Events** (read-only): Get a list of the most common events over the last 31 days.
- **Query Frequency Report** (read-only): Get data about how frequently users are performing events.
- **Query Numeric Average Report** (read-only): Averages an expression for events per unit time.
- **Query Numeric Segmentation Report** (read-only): Get data for an event, segmented and filtered by properties, with values placed into numeric buckets.
- **Query Numeric Sum Report** (read-only): Sums an expression for events per unit time.
